title: How Urvi would work in production for ONGC
intro: Same agent, same tools, real data. ONGC's systems feed the ONGC Enterprise Data Platform (EDP); Urvi reads a governed "Well Health" data product from the EDP; Urvi and Gemini run in Google Cloud India regions; nothing leaves India. AI runs in the cloud, as the EDP RFP places it.

sections.heading: A question, step by step
steps: Users reach Urvi through Identity-Aware Proxy with their ONGC login (single sign-on). Typed and voice traffic both enter here.
The same service as the demo, on Cloud Run in Mumbai, scaling with load.
The same single agent and tools as the demo; role-based access is enforced.
Gemini on Vertex AI India regional endpoints. ONGC data is not used to train models.
The same engineering tools, plus nightly scores from the trained recommendation models.
A new adapter in Urvi's data access layer. It replaces the demo's parquet files.
The adapter reads the Well Health data product through the EDP's API (the RFP allows no direct database queries).

sections.heading: Voice
steps: The Live proxy connects to Gemini Live on an India endpoint at go-live.
Voice tools call the same analytics code as chat.

sections.heading: Where the data comes from
steps: Production / DPR, SCADA + OSI PI, WIS / EDS, SAP, LIMS and DISHA are ingested by the EDP's ingestion layer (UDEL) in ONGC's data centres. Raw Category A data (e.g. raw SCADA) stays there.
Data that ONGC places in the cloud zone travels over a private link (Cloud Interconnect), encrypted.
The EDP cloud zone cleans and curates it into the Well Health data product.
The product is published through the EDP API, which Urvi reads (step 7).

sections.heading: Two other routes (dashed)
body: Route B: the data stays on-prem and Urvi, still in the cloud, reads only the rows it needs from the on-prem EDP API over the private link.
Route P (pilot): before the EDP is live, ONGC exports 10–20 mature Assam wells (names masked) to a landing bucket in Mumbai, so Urvi can be proven on real data in weeks.

sections.heading: How it stays in India and secure
body: Mumbai (asia-south1) is the primary region and Delhi (asia-south2) the disaster-recovery region; both are MeitY-empanelled and accepted as India-resident by the RFP (§3.2.6).

ONGC holds the encryption keys (Cloud KMS, CMEK / EKM); a VPC Service Controls perimeter prevents data copies leaving the project; Access Approval means Google support access needs ONGC's approval; logs stay in India for at least 180 days.

rows: ONGC EDP Well Health product via API
IAP + ONGC single sign-on, role-based access
Models trained on ONGC history (Vertex AI)
